subject.title: [Feature]: Feature Request: Batch Tool Calls + Context Block Management + Plan Enforcement

question: Should OpenClaw pursue any of the requested native core surfaces now: file/search batching, AI-callable context blocks, or runner-enforced submitted plans?
rationale: The request changes core tool schemas, context/session persistence semantics, config surface, and execution policy; VISION.md partially aligns on performance and agent harness work but warns against heavy orchestration layers and optional core growth.

options.title: Split For Design Review
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and ask maintainers to sponsor narrower design tracks for any surface they want to pursue.

options.title: Defer To Existing Seams
options.body: Route pieces through current plugin/context-engine/Parallel Search surfaces unless a concrete missing core API is proven.

options.title: Close As Out Of Scope
options.body: Decide that native batching, context-block, and plan-enforcement orchestration is not planned for core at this time.

recommendation.title: Split For Design Review
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and ask maintainers to sponsor narrower design tracks for any surface they want to pursue.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest adjacent history on structured planning, tool schemas, and web-search surfaces.
